entries.text: AC-1..AC-5 complete: configuration/runbook_catalog.py (Runbook dataclass + register_runbook()/validate_runbook_steps(), fail-closed on an unregistered/non-CLASS_0/vendor-mismatched step, independent of but consistent with command_primitives.register_primitive's own gate) + application/workflows/runbook.py wiring main.py --runbook-execute --runbook-id <id> (application/cli.py; the parser/validate_modes surface for this flag pair was already present, uncommitted, from an interrupted prior attempt at this same backlog item in this worktree -- inspected, found correct, completed rather than redone). One concrete example runbook: cp_basic_health_check (Check Point, reuses CE.2's cp_gaia_show_version_all proof primitive). Requirement explicitly verified: this shares CE.2's PRIMITIVE_REGISTRY outright -- every resolved runbook step is the literal registry object (identity-checked in tests), no second registry, no new command, no new credential path, no new redaction rule (reuses CE.2's redact() unchanged). 15 new tests (tests/test_pcp8_diagnostic_runbooks.py, tests/test_pcp8_diagnostic_runbooks_cli.py) prove validator rejection (unregistered step, fabricated CLASS_1 step, vendor mismatch, empty sequence) and an end-to-end mocked-transport run proving raw command output never survives into the written artifact. Full regression 3157 passed/27 skipped/2 failed (same pre-existing DLP-token-collision pair as origin/main; a third apparent parallel-run failure was an unrelated pre-existing pytest-xdist scratch-file race, confirmed non-reproducing). Privacy gate PASS/0 new findings. git diff --check clean. Merged via PR #159 (merge commit 86ed3657f08d79023b405c6f23b7d5b67dd29f0a) under standing relay#13 self-merge authorization after CI validate passed. AC-6 judgment call: backlog status set to automated_validated, not the literally-requested done -- this layer's own automated coverage is complete, but every step it can run executes through CE.2's own primitives, whose real-device output-shape confirmation is still owed (no live device reachable here), matching CE.2's own backlog precedent and AGENTS.md's 'never mark a network-facing behavior DONE from automated tests alone.'
